g.text: Raise a support ticket, share feedback about SevaKhata, or report a problem with a profile verification.
We keep your message in the project’s feedback file. Fields marked * are required.
Sunita Didi confirmed her entries on the same evening. No more arguments at month end, which is a big relief.
You do not need a ticket for that.

Open the shared ledger and choose “Dispute” on the entry, with a short reason. It stays out of the balance until the employer corrects and resends it. Raise a ticket here only if something is still unresolved.
Only the subject is shown. Contact details stay private.
